headline_stat.name: Fraction significantly theta phase-locked (Rayleigh p<0.001): excitatory / inhibitory

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1) is the canonical known-good dataset for hippocampal theta entrainment, with silicon-probe LFP and sorted units during linear-track running.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from S3 via remfile, correct epoch/unit alignment, cell-type metadata applied, and tracker dropouts handled carefully by computing speed per contiguous tracked bout so gaps cannot be misread as running.
justification.analysis: Rayleigh test with MRL is the correct circular statistic, and it is corroborated by two phase-free signatures (spike-triggered average and autocorrelogram) plus an amplitude-vs-speed sanity check.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (44.6%/100% significant, mean MRL 0.240/0.224, Pearson r=0.109) reproduces exactly from the committed script output and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, and the example units are honestly chosen, including a genuinely non-entrained pyramidal cell (MRL=0.04, uniform histogram) as a negative control.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and no result is misrepresented, but the write-up states no explicit limitation (single session, single channel), placing a genuinely clean strong result at level 3 rather than 4.
justification.verdict: Thorough, reproducible, and honest CA1 theta-entrainment analysis with independent cross-checks; I would accept this from a rotation student.
